# A formation's couplings as its blanket, and when a blanket constrains

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-formations-couplings-as-its-blanket` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](a-formations-couplings-as-its-blanket.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Any model fed by what couples into a formation is by construction the agent of a blanketed law whose sensory course is the formation's own course; a degenerate reading refutes no family whose law is determined, while a sparse partition fixed apart from the family can be refuted by one run.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The coupling law: where a formation's couplings give the values of what couples into it, any model and policy, and any environment, which may read the act, make a blanketed law whose sensory part's next state is the value of what couples in at the step, the step on the world's side; its sensory course is the formation's own course through its couplings under its own level history (sensory_course and four more). (`Becoming.BlanketCouplings.couplingLaw`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.startAt`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.clock`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ownLevels`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.sensory_course`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Two of its courses from one agent are alike on the blanket before n + 2 exactly where their own level histories are alike through the couplings up to n, the environment reading the act or not; then their internal courses agree up to n + 2. In the closed loop both sides are read off one course (blanket_iff_through, internal_through_couplings). (`Becoming.BlanketCouplings.blanket_iff_through`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.internal_through_couplings`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. In the open loop, the act moving no level, every reading of the internal course up to n + 2 is a selection through the formation's couplings up to n, whatever the model and the policy (internal_selectsThrough and five more). (`Becoming.BlanketCouplings.levelsAt`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.levelsStay`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.openLoop`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.open_external`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.open_levels`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.internal_selectsThrough`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. The threshold witness's join is its case: at the witness's web, with the supply as the environment state beside the step, the two courses correspond part by part and the witness's blanket_iff_through follows (ThresholdCase.threshold_case and ten more). (`Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ThresholdCase.value`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ThresholdCase.lev`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ThresholdCase.env`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ThresholdCase.update`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ThresholdCase.policy`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ThresholdCase.band_congr`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ThresholdCase.admits_iff`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ThresholdCase.values`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ThresholdCase.corr`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ThresholdCase.own_eq`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ThresholdCase.threshold_case`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. A part of the next configuration depends only on a reading where configurations agreeing under one map go, under one move, to ones agreeing under another; DependsOnlyOn and GoAlike are cases by definition, and Determined is equivalent to the case where both are the identity; the law a family shows has such a part exactly where the family is consistent under the two maps (shownBy_partDependsOnlyOn_iff and five more). <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Any web, formation and couplings by level, supplied, whose values the web's admission and the levels give (ValuesThrough); any model, policy, environment state, levels and environment step.
- For the readings: any family of courses with moves, and any map from configurations to four parts, read by one map at every step of a law the same at every step.
- Modelling choices: discrete synchronous steps; determined laws; the four parts of types in Type; the blanket as sparse coupling, not conditional independence; which map a thing's partition is read by is not derived.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That having the coupling law constrains a formation's course: it is a construction, the step on the world's side and the environment arbitrary.
- The formation's own record as the internal part: the agent is a model fed by what couples in.
- The World's own exchange as an environment: the World's case is the open loop, the closed loop a model beside it.
- A blanketed law for every family consistent part by part: a next state at every reading no course shows is needed.
- That the principle is wrong: no sentence of its literature is forbidden here.
- **Counterexample:** The run whose internal part's next state is whether the external part, cycling through three values, is at its first is the course of no blanketed law on its four parts (ReadsExternal.not_blanketed). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/BlanketCouplings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** With the step but not which course outside, two courses alike at steps 0 and 1 and parting at 2 have no law determined part by part (clock_only_fails). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/BlanketCouplings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Under the identity reading, injective, a run whose law is determined is not consistent part by part (injective_converse_fails). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/BlanketCouplings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Two courses from one value parting at their first step: the family is not consistent, its clocked reading consistent part by part (clocked_witness). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/BlanketCouplings.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The principle defines a thing by its Markov blanket (Friston 2013, 2019; Kirchhoff, Parr, Palacios, Friston and Kiverstein 2018). That a blanket depends on how a partition is read is argued in words: Pearl's blankets, fixed within a model, against Friston's, read as a thing's boundary (Bruineberg, Dołęga, Dewhurst and Baltieri 2022). The wider criticism: a formalism applying to any domain is a narrower account of life and mind than claimed (Raja, Valluri, Baggs, Chemero and Anderson 2021); the statistical and dynamical definitions are not equivalent (Biehl, Pollock and Kanai 2021); the proponents class the existence claim with principles of stationary action, not falsifiable strictly speaking (Ramstead and others 2023). The coupling form is the deterministic case of the time-unrolled blanket (Virgo, Rosas and Biehl 2022); since that blanket compares courses from one start, a single run constrains nothing under it. The single-run witness is of the kind of Hexagram.runsOrder_reads. AI reading: which blanket a thing has is how its parts are read; the join is a construction and forbids nothing of the formation's course. The readings are the AI's, in DESIGN.md.
